decision_skill.name: prefer_parsimonious_cycle_median
decision_skill.description: Select a direct same-position cycle median when the target exhibits a repeating cadence and more elaborate detrending or weekday adjustments are not supported by enough history.
decision_skill.applicability: When forecasting a short horizon from regularly sampled data with an evident cycle and limited observations for estimating additional structure.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Among safe candidates, prefer the assumption with the fewest unsupported components that preserves the dominant observed periodicity; use same-cycle-position conditional medians unless validation or strong evidence demonstrates material drift or weekday effects.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when the cycle is unstable, recent regime changes invalidate historical positions, sufficient backtesting favors a trend-aware model, or verified evidence requires a directional adjustment.
